meta.title: Aero — Lightweight Web Saver
meta.description: A lightweight Chrome extension that lets you save anything from the web and find it later instantly.

hero.name: Aero
hero.tagline: A better way to remember the internet.

features.title: Save Anything
features.body: Clip articles, ideas, links, or anything from the web in one click.

features.title: Search by Meaning
features.body: Find saved content the way you remember it — not just by URL or title.

features.title: Fully Local
features.body: Everything is stored locally on your device. No login, no cloud, no tracking.

features.title: Blazing Fast
features.body: Built to be lightweight and instant. No lag, no waiting.

steps.title: Install Extension
steps.body: Add Aero to Chrome in one click.

steps.title: Save Anything
steps.body: Click once on any webpage to save it instantly.

steps.title: Find Instantly
steps.body: Search your saved content by ideas, not links.

cta.heading: Never lose the web again
cta.sub: Aero keeps your internet memories organized and searchable.
cta.label: Get Aero
